subject: delta(client): WF give the retained native lane world the receipt limits and a matching seller receipt, and pick a recorded commit in the inventory test
note: A composition with native payment now needs receipt fee ceilings and a mandate cap, and the read-only composition still has the receipt reservation reader, so the lane read world passes the same limits as the other composition worlds and seeds each purchase with a seller receipt that equals its price plus both ceilings. The read-only reader list gains that reader. The inventory test picks the last commit that has to have an inventory row, so a commit that changes only the README, which needs no row, is not chosen.
